_about: Ingestion profiles for the Generate Data path (request field ingestion_profile on /api/generate/preview and /api/runs). Generated from src/netspout_core/ingestion_profiles.py; the default is direct for every sourcetype and only the sourcetypes below accept another profile.

cisco:ios.direct: the vendor syslog text exactly as generated; HEC source network-topology-simulator; host = generated device
cisco:ios.sc4s: raw = '%FAC-SEV-MNEM: text' (the original syslog header removed); HEC source 'sc4s'; HEC host = the device address taken from the original header; _time = explicit HEC time because the raw carries no timestamp

cisco:ise:syslog.direct: the vendor syslog text exactly as generated; HEC source network-topology-simulator; host = generated device
cisco:ise:syslog.sc4s: raw = '<stamp> <device address> <original stamp> <node> CISE_...' (no <PRI>); HEC source 'sc4s'; HEC host = the device address; _time = explicit HEC time (the add-on's own TIME_PREFIX also parses the in-event time, checked through the raw endpoint)

not_evidenced_and_not_produced: sc4s_* indexed fields (only their names were observed)
SC4S host timezone: the real ISE line carries a local and a UTC stamp that differ by the SC4S host offset; NetSpout renders both in UTC
UDP/TCP syslog framing for the sc4s profile (HEC only was tested)

field_ownership.rule: bare vendor/CIM field names (action, signature, status, src_ip, dest_ip, protocol, vendor, node_type) are not sent for these sourcetypes; the netspout_ copies are
